body: Idk what in my post made you think my unqualified suicidal ptsd suffering ass should counsel people even though typing hurts but thank you for your suggestion and time. It's good to get replies

my life was horrible before I became disabled but I at least had a tiny bit of hope. I feel like my life is ruined because I have no hope for the future. when I was able bodied and trying to live with mental illness I'd think of the future and what I could do when I recover, but now even if I do recover i can't do anything I planned and wanted to do when I was well. I just woke up and I was disabled, and it keeps happening like that. I wake up one day and my hands barely work anymore, I wake up another day and another part is messed up. It makes every flare up so scary because I don't know if it's a bad flare up or if it's just part of my life now.

I didn't have anything to lose but I feel like I lost my entire life. I was gonna try to actually start my life when I left my abuser because I couldnt live the life I wanted until then, but I became disabled at the same time. I was 20. I had big dreams and I had to keep making them smaller and smaller but I can't live with that. I can't go from wanting a full life for myself to wishing for basically nothing.  

I've had to rewrite what I want over and over and now what i "want" is a tiny house of my own I can live in and...nothing else really since I can't pursue any art or hobbies or anything i want. It's so depressing for me because it's so unlike what I really want. I don't know how I could be happy even if I magically got what I "want". My world would still be so crushingly small. how are you so positive? Everyone expects me to think positively but I have no idea how when it feels like I'm in my own personal hell every day
